Each Loan Party agrees to the foregoing, and each Guarantor ratifies and reaffirms its guaranty of the Obligations after giving effect to the foregoing. This letter agreement shall not be effective until the Agent has received a duly executed counterpart hereto from the Parent Borrower, the other Loan Parties and the undersigned Lenders. Nothing in this letter amendment shall be deemed to be an amendment of any provisions of the Credit Agreement other than as expressly set forth above.
